description: The chart is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the percentage distribution of three components—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two different methods, labeled "Ours" and "Standard". The vertical axis serves as the category axis, displaying the two methods with "Ours" positioned at the top and "Standard" at the bottom, without an explicit axis label. The horizontal axis functions as the value axis measuring percentages; it lacks an explicit axis line, label, or tick marks, as the total length of each stacked bar implicitly represents 100%. The bars are stacked horizontally, with each full bar divided into three color-coded segments corresponding to the legend at the bottom: blue represents "Context", orange represents "Generated Response", and green represents "Other". Each segment is directly annotated with its exact percentage value. For the "Ours" category, the bar consists of a 60.6% blue segment, a 31.7% orange segment, and a 7.7% green segment. For the "Standard" category, the bar is composed of a 23.6% blue segment, a 51.1% orange segment, and a 25.3% green segment. Across the chart, the largest individual segment is the blue "Context" segment in the "Ours" bar at 60.6%, while the smallest is the green "Other" segment in the same bar at 7.7%. The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted in a specific alphabetical or numerical order, and the segments within each bar follow a consistent left-to-right order of blue, orange, and green. The percentage values are visually emphasized through direct text annotations centered within each corresponding colored segment.
